plan.preserve: Every planned call, stdout/stderr, PID/timestamps, failures, and all monitor samples; no activity filtering or automatic replacement.
limitations: Two process calls per model/workload/arm, one measured repeat after warmup each; all directional samples retained. Few-percent differences require matched layout/noise assessment before attribution.
All arms use four threads on CPU0-3/quota4, ubatch512 and F32 K/V. CPU activity and device clocks monitored identically. No clock/power changes.

Main/candidate were built from Git archives in the same image at the same /work path with identical flags, both version unknown; source, binary and library hashes verified. Public main d27 runtime matches7184.
Reference revision eefc4e is pinned, not a claim about latest mx. No reference arm for Qwen3.5; its comparison here is solely to main.

Identical LCG seeds12345/777 and token range min(1000,vocab); each phase resets history. TG128 is not generation after the measured prompt. Loading/warmup excluded from rates but included in activity windows.
mx allocates context max(512,p,n); llmx retains model logical context and fits physical cache to max(p,n) for this single-sequence bench. KV allocation layouts differ.
Unknown monitoring remains unknown. No failed, slow or active interval is discarded or replaced. There is no idle-machine claim.

Full-model performance does not establish correctness. Completed HF and native results remain separate. New-type speed deficits are recorded under first-support rule, which never excuses existing-path regressions.
admission: Native65/65 and Linux CPU/Vulkan suites terminalpass; main/candidate sourcepins and buildhashes match retained proofs.
GPU0 availability and auto clocks, container/image/resources, all models and reference artifacts are checked before timing.
No owned rig build/test/download concurrent with timing; unrelated activity monitored, no activity-based exclusion.

mx.required_recheck: actual F32-KV Vulkan adapter source/hash, linked libraries and --list-devices; do not substitute CPU or default-f16-KV wrapper
mx.linked_library_manifest: .tmp-half-weight-perf-20261002/cpu-initial/mx-reference.json reference_artifacts; reuse only matching GPU build-r2 libraries, not that manifest CPU executable

preflight_failures: model-timing/complete.json: legacy unanchored /models/ replacement changed an absolute fixture path; zero timing calls run. Corrected only path mapping.

analysis.scope: Read-only activity/rate reconciliation of terminal model-timing-v2 block. No gate or causal interpretation.

activity_flag_semantics.cpu_busy: first 8 /proc/stat counters only (user..steal; guest fields are not captured), busy iff idle <25%;
activity_flag_semantics.unrelated_cpu: any single observed unrelated process >=100% of one CPU, ticks/sec from monitor metadata;
activity_flag_semantics.disk_activity: any whole disk device >50,000,000 B/s using read+write sectors*512 over sample delta; per-device maximum, not sum/average across layered devices;

limitations: Full raw activity samples and original stdout/stderr/usage remain in the source directory; summary does not modify them.
Activity flags are observed thresholds, not causal attribution or automatic run rejection.
CPU/process/disk/GPU observations are sample-based; short-lived or missed/inaccessible processes remain unknown.
Disk unknowns stay unknown; maximum disk throughput is one device at a time, not aggregate across layered devices.
Per-call activity overlaps interval boundaries and must not be summed as unique intervals.
Benchmark cgroup and monitor/supervisor are separately excluded; other docker wrappers remain classified by observed cgroup and are not inferred away.
GPU busy/VRAM has no declared threshold; missing counter values are unknown, not zero.

setup_failures: First launcher used wrong functional-result field; next preflight used legacy unanchored model alias translation. Both stopped before timing, retained separately. Corrected only harness; all80planned measured calls ran once.

followups.q5_1: Both measured phases exceed pinned mx; no claim for unmeasured workloads/platforms.
followups.iq4_nl: Prefill exceeds mx; decode about49.5percent below. Profile row lookup/dot occupancy and compare reference dispatch before optimizing the existing row owner.
followups.f16_bf16: Prefill below reference; F16 decode also below, BF16 decode above. Profile shared floating-weight row/tile products, retaining exact widening and existing arithmetic budgets.
followups.existing_paths: Full-model ranges -0.74 to+2.61percent against main include a slow initial main Qwen3.5 sample and activity flags. No samples discarded; same-owner scratch layout control is being built before attributing small differences.
